2.2.1. om_integration.pi_program.extract_unmatched_vars_from_seif_prog¶

om_integration.pi_program.extract_unmatched_vars_from_seif_prog(prog)¶

Returns the name of all variables in the given program that were not matched with a with an input or equation in the PiSPEC model.

Requires the Prover iLock package iLock_SEIF to be available.

Parameters:

prog – A program from the internal Prover iLock code model that has been merged with a SEIF program using iLock_SEIF.
